# Start here

Five steps for anyone producing a dataset, model or agent workflow. Each step links to the tool and to the part of the guideline it comes from.

<div class="px-steps" markdown>

<div class="px-step" markdown>
<span class="px-step__n" aria-hidden="true">1</span>

### Find your role

Developer, data or platform provider, use case lead or deployer, reviewer: the role decides which requirements are yours.

[:octicons-arrow-right-24: Roles at a glance](../at-a-glance.md#who-does-what)

Source: [Section 2 · Introduction](../guideline/02-introduction.md#roles-and-responsibilities) · [Annex F · PROTEUS Roles and Partner Mapping](../guideline/18-annex-f-proteus-roles-and-partner-mapping.md)
{: .px-source }
</div>

<div class="px-step" markdown>
<span class="px-step__n" aria-hidden="true">2</span>

### Check your risk tier

Answer a few yes/no questions to get an indicative tier: low, medium or high.

[:octicons-arrow-right-24: Risk-tier self-check](risk-check.md)

Source: [Section 4 · Foundation Model Risks](../guideline/04-foundation-model-risks.md) · [Annex H · PROTEUS Risk-Tier Examples](../guideline/20-annex-h-proteus-risk-tier-examples.md)
{: .px-source }
</div>

<div class="px-step" markdown>
<span class="px-step__n" aria-hidden="true">3</span>

### Go through the checklist for your stage

Filter the requirements by your role and current lifecycle stage and tick them off.

[:octicons-arrow-right-24: Requirements checklist](checklist.md)

Source: [Section 7 · Requirements by Lifecycle Stage](../guideline/07-requirements-by-lifecycle-stage.md) · [Annex A · Requirements Checklist](../guideline/13-annex-a-requirements-checklist.md)
{: .px-source }
</div>

<div class="px-step" markdown>
<span class="px-step__n" aria-hidden="true">4</span>

### Fill in the compliance card at each stage gate

At data collection, model training and release, record the status, justification and evidence for each parameter.

[:octicons-arrow-right-24: Compliance card](compliance-card.md)

Source: [Annex B · Compliance Card and JSON Schema](../guideline/14-annex-b-compliance-card-and-json-schema.md) · [Section 10 · Compliance Assessment Process](../guideline/10-compliance-assessment-process.md)
{: .px-source }
</div>

<div class="px-step" markdown>
<span class="px-step__n" aria-hidden="true">5</span>

### Send the card to the RAI reviewer (HZDR) before release

Email the card or attach it to a GitHub issue, and raise open issues through the escalation path.

[:octicons-arrow-right-24: How to submit](compliance-card.md#how-to-submit)

Source: [Section 10 · Compliance Assessment Process](../guideline/10-compliance-assessment-process.md) · [Section 12 · Governance and Monitoring](../guideline/12-governance-and-monitoring.md) · [Annex F · PROTEUS Roles and Partner Mapping](../guideline/18-annex-f-proteus-roles-and-partner-mapping.md)
{: .px-source }
</div>

</div>

!!! info "Just exploring?"
    You only need steps 4–5 when you are actually producing a dataset, model or release.
